profile.headline: Solving Complex Technical Problems Through Code / Bringing joy to winter through teaching snowboarding
profile.summary:
I'm a backend engineer who thrives on building reliable systems at scale—from processing petabytes of retail data at Amazon to preventing $1M in penalties through observability infrastructure at Avaya, to handling 1M+ monthly requests for 2,300+ Home Depot stores.

My career has been driven by a simple philosophy: anticipate problems before they become crises. Whether it's leading an initiative that avoided $5M in potential fines through instant order cancellations, or building comprehensive monitoring that catches failures before customers notice, I focus on creating systems that don't just work—they work reliably under pressure.

Over 10+ years at companies like Amazon, Spoken (acquired by Avaya), and The Home Depot, I've architected solutions spanning distributed systems, real-time communications, and enterprise-wide data platforms. I love the challenge of taking complex technical problems and turning them into elegant, scalable solutions that drive measurable business impact.

Beyond writing code, I'm passionate about elevating teams—whether mentoring junior engineers on best coding practices or collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals.

**Tech Stack:** Java, Python, SQL • Spring Boot • GCP, Kubernetes, Docker • Kafka, Pub/Sub, BigQuery • Prometheus, Grafana

Currently exploring new opportunities where I can architect distributed systems that impact millions of users and revenue, while mentoring teams to deliver resilient, scalable solutions.

**Let's connect!** Always happy to chat about software architecture, reliability engineering, or career growth in tech.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led phased Kafka-to-GCP Pub/Sub migration of a 700K messages/day order service across 2,300+ stores with no data loss, coordinating cutover and testing with 5 external teams.
  -- Served as single point of contact for partner teams, aligning on cutover sequencing, integration test schedules, and rollout timing
  -- Upgraded service from Spring Boot 2.x to 4.x, resolving breaking changes across the dependency stack

- Developed enterprise-wide synchronization system to maintain real-time data consistency across 2,300+ stores
  -- Processed 1 million requests monthly with <60s SLA 
  -- Ensured automated, bidirectional synchronization between legacy and modern data platforms 
  -- Synchronized 63 task alert types across 5 categories (order, delivery, install, measure, willcall) 

- Led the initiative for stop sale cancellations to avoid ~$5M/year in potential fines
-- Reduced item-level order cancellation process from a full engineering day to near-instant
-- Supported 20K messages per hour with improved reliability and reduced order processing delays 
-- Deployed and configured microservices across production environments using cdk8s to establish scalable infrastructure 

- Leveraged Claude Code with Slack Integration to respond to commonly-asked questions on the on-call channel

- Mentored 2 junior engineers on infrastructure setup and best coding practices
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Code · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Pioneered and implemented a comprehensive observability platform across 50+ instances, preventing $1M in SLA penalties and thousands of dropped calls 
    -- Led a team of 2 in building observability stack using Prometheus/Victoria Metrics/Grafana
    -- Enabled proactive alerting on concurrent call counts, call volumes, and host health
    -- Prevented potential failures during sudden instance replacements through early detection

- Architected real-time chat functionality  supporting 1,000+ concurrent agent supervisor connections
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · Spring Boot · Java

positions.title: Snowboard Instructor
positions.description:
- Used proven methods to teach snowboarding to adults and kids
- Set up and break down before and after the day
- Attends training sessions to improve my teaching
- Attained L1, CS1, FS1 certifications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

- Improved demand forecast accuracy by 15% by engineering scalable ETL pipelines that processed 1TB+ of seasonal data, incorporating promotional events and seasonal patterns into forecasting models, collaborating with data scientists and product managers
